xln.text: Kumena, a River Herald Shaper, argues at the Wellspring that the River Heralds must wield the Immortal Sun themselves, while his former teacher Tishana insists it must be kept hidden and unused, and Kopala sides with Tishana.
Kumena drowns the captured Sun Empire soldier and rushes off, and when Tishana catches up with him on the coast, he conjures storms against approaching ships, then knocks her out with a punch.
Tishana tells Huatli that a River Herald, Kumena, has betrayed her cause and is heading to Orazca, and Kumena races there, reaches the Threefold Temple and awakens the city and its creatures.
Vona and Mavren Fein overpower him and throw him from the Tower of Triumph, though Tishana saves him.

j25.text: Kumena decides that the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city is to claim its power for himself.
